First, convert the given date: 05-09-1183 is DD-MM-YYYY → 1183-09-05.  

Subtract 48 weeks and 5 days:  
48 weeks = 48 × 7 = 336 days.  
Plus 5 days = 341 days total to subtract.  

1183 is not a leap year (leap years divisible by 4, but 1183 not divisible by 4).  
From 1183-09-05, go back 341 days:  

Step back to 1183-01-01 from 1183-09-05:  
Jan (31) + Feb (28) + Mar (31) + Apr (30) + May (31) + Jun (30) + Jul (31) + Aug (31) = 243 days in Jan–Aug.  
Sept 5 → 5 days in Sept.  
So days from 1183-01-01 to 1183-09-05 = 243 + 5 = 248 days.  

We need to go back 341 days from 1183-09-05.  
First go back 248 days to 1183-01-01.  
Remaining = 341 − 248 = 93 days to go back further into 1182.  

1182 is not a leap year (not divisible by 4).  
Go back from 1183-01-01:  
Dec 1182 has 31 days → 93 − 31 = 62 left.  
Nov 1182 has 30 days → 62 − 30 = 32 left.  
Oct 1182 has 31 days → 32 − 31 = 1 left.  
So back 1 more day from Oct 1, 1182 → Sept 30, 1182.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1182-09-30
